s1.syndrome_frame: Palpitations with chest pain and lightheadedness
salient_findings: Narrow QRS regular tachycardia triggering a nonsustained phase of wide complex irregular tachycardia
Wide complex configuration until spontaneous termination
Tachycardia with a cycle length of 250 ms
key_facts: No family history of sudden cardiac death

shortlist.label: Atrioventricular Nodal Reentrant Tachycardia
shortlist.why_kept: Narrow QRS regular tachycardia triggering wide complex irregular tachycardia is consistent with AVNRT

shortlist.label: Orthodromic Atrioventricular Reentrant Tachycardia
shortlist.why_kept: Electrophysiology study revealed tachycardia with a cycle length of 250 ms, consistent with Orthodromic AVRT

shortlist.label: Supraventricular Tachycardia with Aberrancy
shortlist.why_kept: Wide complex configuration until spontaneous termination suggests SVT with aberrancy

shortlist.label: Ventricular Tachycardia
shortlist.why_kept: Wide complex irregular tachycardia could be indicative of VT, although less likely given the clinical context

shortlist.label: Wolff-Parkinson-White Syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of wide complex tachycardia and narrow QRS regular tachycardia suggests possible WPW syndrome

raw.rationale: The patient's smartwatch recording showed a narrow QRS regular tachycardia triggering a nonsustained phase of wide complex irregular tachycardia, which is consistent with supraventricular tachycardia with aberrancy. The electrophysiology study also revealed tachycardia with a cycle length of 250 ms, which supports this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Atrioventricular Nodal Reentrant Tachycardia
rejected.why: Lack of specific evidence for AV nodal reentry

rejected.label: Orthodromic Atrioventricular Reentrant Tachycardia
rejected.why: No evidence of an accessory electrical pathway

rejected.label: Ventricular Tachycardia
rejected.why: The initial tachycardia was narrow QRS, suggesting a supraventricular origin

rejected.label: Wolff-Parkinson-White Syndrome
rejected.why: No evidence of pre-excitation or an accessory pathway on the initial ECG
